headline: Pemex Pipeline Fire in Jalisco Burns Three People Following Fuel Leak
summary: A fuel leak on a Pemex pipeline caught fire in Tototlán, Jalisco, leaving three people severely burned.
why: Accidents involving state-owned energy infrastructure can raise operational, safety, and regulatory concerns for national oil companies.
